description.en: Plugins built and published from this machine.
description.zh: 在这台机器上构建并发布的插件。

description.en: Choose which backend generate_image talks to, and keep a key per backend. Ships with local Stable Diffusion (127.0.0.1:1235), Volcengine Ark / Doubao Seedream, AutoDL.Art and any OpenAI-compatible /images/generations service; add, edit or remove backends yourself. Open Settings → Image routing (right after Models) and press "Set default" on a backend — that choice is pushed into dsh-model-think-level, so later generate_image calls need no model argument. "Test" spends one real generation on the selected backend (local is free, cloud calls are billed by that provider). Keys are stored in ~/.dsh/image-switch/keys.json (mode 600) and never written into the profile config; when no key is saved the plugin falls back to the backend's env var or the ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml refs. Turning the bundle off removes the Settings page and the image_router tool, and the standalone endpoint on port 1236 stops listening, so generate_image falls back to whatever provider rows the profile still declares.
description.zh: 决定 generate_image 走哪个后端，并给每个后端单独存密钥。内置本地 Stable Diffusion（127.0.0.1:1235）、火山方舟豆包 Seedream、AutoDL.Art，以及任意 OpenAI 兼容的 /images/generations 服务；后端可以自己加、改、删。打开「设置 → 生图路由」（紧跟在「模型」后面），在某个后端上点「设为默认」——这个选择会同步写进 dsh-model-think-level，之后调用 generate_image 不用再写 model。「测试」会在该后端上真跑一张（本地免费，云端按各家计费）。密钥存在 ~/.dsh/image-switch/keys.json（权限 600），不写进 profile 配置；没存密钥时依次回退到后端的密钥变量名和 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 的 refs。关掉这个 bundle 会移除设置页和 image_router 工具，1236 上的独立端点也会停止监听，generate_image 回到 profile 里仍然声明的那些 provider 行。
